scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,client,worker -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w worker"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w client
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:worker: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w worker
